summary: Freenome, Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 7.01, 8.01 and 9.01 announcing the commercial launch of its SimpleScreen Lung blood test and a combined single-draw lung-plus-colorectal screening offering. No transaction, stake, price, premium or advisor is disclosed. The release cites validation data: 85% sensitivity and 50% specificity with 99.8% negative predictive value in a 172-case/436-control cohort, plus PREEMPT CRC results of 81% sensitivity and 99.9% NPV. This is an ordinary product-launch disclosure, not a special situation; watch reimbursement and payer coverage rather than deal terms.
